column2: This part switches on the robot's intelligence: Telegram for commands from your phone, Claude for thinking and seeing, Groq for hearing. Each service is tested on its own before the full brain code is uploaded.

Estimated Claude cost

The default model in the code is claude-haiku-5-5, the cheapest Claude model. Anthropic's model page lists prices starting at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens. One robot chat uses about 1,000-1,500 input tokens (robot rules + history + sensor data) and about 100 tokens of answer, so roughly $0.0002 or about Rp3 per chat at an exchange rate around Rp16,000. A 640x480 photo adds about 400 tokens. Prices and exchange rates can change; check the pricing page.
Required: set a monthly spending limit in the console (Settings → Limits), for example $5, so code stuck in a loop cannot drain your balance.
Install the intelligence
Create the Telegram bot
The bot sends "Halo dari ESP32-S3!" and replies to every message you send.
OK to lock in The bot token and chat ID.
Not yet Do not upload them to GitHub or send them to anyone. If they leak, create a new bot.
GAGAL kirim: the token was mistyped (it must be complete, with the numbers and the colon), the chat ID is wrong, or you have not pressed Start in the bot.
WiFi does not connect: the ESP32 only supports 2.4 GHz.
Claude API key

Why this way? This code sends the question in JSON format to api.anthropic.com/v1/messages over HTTPS. The connection is encrypted, but for simplicity the server certificate is not checked (setInsecure). That is fine for this home project; do not use this pattern for sensitive data.
The AI answer appears within a few seconds. Code 401 = wrong key, 400 with a balance message = empty balance, 429 = too many requests.
OK to lock in The Claude API key and the monthly spending limit.
Not yet The key is shown only once. Do not put it in a file that will be uploaded.
Speech to text with Groq (optional)
You have a gsk_ key ready to fill into the brain code.
OK to lock in The Groq key (may be left empty).
Not yet Voice recordings are sent to Groq's servers. If you object, leave the key empty.
Install the audio library and upload the brain code
The full code is about 770 lines: download robot_otak.ino. Do not upload a file that already contains the token and API key to a public place.

The screen shows a face with two blinking eyes, the status line at the top shows the battery and the distance from the body, the speaker says "Halo, aku Robi. Aku siap.", and the bot sends "Robi menyala".
OK to lock in The filled-in robot_otak.ino (WiFi, token, chat ID, API key, KAMERA_ALAMAT, robot name). The touch calibration is stored on the S3.
Not yet A file that already contains keys must not be uploaded to a public place. The wheels stay lifted.
Compile error "Audio.h: No such file": the audio library was not installed from the ZIP.
Keeps restarting with a PSRAM message: the PSRAM menu is not set to OPI PSRAM.
badan belum terhubung on the screen: check the UART wires and GND (Part 3 Stage 6).
No sound but the speaker test worked: Google TTS may be refusing right now. The answer is still sent through Telegram.
Try every ability
Try this
What happens
Hold the FORWARD/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT buttons on the screen
the robot moves while your finger is on it and stops when you let go
Tap STOP on the screen
motors and sound stop, the mode returns to normal
Tap the robot's face
the screen shows the camera for 10 seconds (tap again to leave)
Tap SPEAK, then talk for 4 seconds
your voice is turned into text, answered by the AI, spoken aloud and sent to Telegram
